case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored transaction 3503878, an online purchase of $99.92 on product R, with a risk score of 0.90. The strongest findings are that the rare device profile "Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720" has been used on only five cards ever, appearing on four other cards within 30 days with amounts within 2 % of this purchase, a pattern that is 10.7 times more common in confirmed fraud than in normal traffic, and the cardholder denied making the transaction while still possessing the card. The verdict is fraud with a probability of 0.96. The recommended actions are to block the card, create a case, file a report, and monitor the connected cards.

sar.narrative: The cardholder identified as customer C07987, holder of visa credit card C07987-K2, was reported to have an unauthorized transaction on 2016-12-01 at 17:28:53. The flagged purchase, transaction ID 3503878, was for $99.92 and was processed online under product code R in billing region 264. The purchase originated from a Windows device using an "other" operating system designation, Chrome 61.0 browser, and a 1280x720 screen resolution. This device profile has been observed on only five cards in total, including four other cards (C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, C11309-K1) within the preceding 30 days, and the amounts on those cards were within 2 % of the $99.92 amount, a pattern that is 10.7 times more common in confirmed fraud than in normal online traffic. The cardholder denied making the purchase, stated they did not share card details, and confirmed they still possess the card. Because the transaction was card-not-present, executed from a rare device profile used across multiple customers, and the cardholder's denial aligns with known fraud indicators, the activity was deemed suspicious and classified as fraud. Subsequent actions included blocking card C07987-K2, creating case HHG-019, filing a Suspicious Activity Report, and monitoring the connected cards.

stop_reason: The customer's reply settled the question (section 6): probability moved from 0.70 to 0.96 and the episode (1 transaction(s), $99.92) is scoped. Further steps would not change the actions.
